Title: Parosmia: Why Fried Food Suddenly Smells Rotten

Description:
About fifteen high-potency odor compounds have been traced as the main culprits in parosmia — they hijack the smell signal for coffee, meat, onion, and garlic, so instead of a normal aroma your brain reads burnt or rotten.

Let hot food cool before it hits your nose, keep up daily smell retraining with four distinct scents, and see an ENT if it's dragging on with no improvement.
